health.heart_none: No heart-rate source dey this phone yet. Connect health app or band to Health Connect.

health.measure: Check your heart with di camera

heart.trend_better: E dey better — di recent readings lower pass before.

health.hosp_location: No location yet. On GPS, go outside or near window, open this tab again.
health.gym_none: No gym or stadium maap near you yet.
